001: I'm looking for an apartment for next month.
Do you have an idea of the neighborhood you prefer?
I'd really like to be close to the city center.
It's often more expensive, but more convenient.
Yes, I'm ready to pay a bit more for that.
I'll look at the listings with you.
002: I saw a listing for a nice studio.
Oh really? What neighborhood is it in?
It's near the park, it's very quiet.
And the rent, is it reasonable?
Yes, six hundred fifty euros per month.
That's a good deal, you should call.
003: Hello, I'm calling about the listing.
Yes, hello, are you interested in the studio?
Yes, it's available starting the first of the month.
Perfect, can I come see it tomorrow?
Of course, I'll set up an appointment with you at six in the evening.
004: So, how did the visit go?
The apartment is nice, but a little small.
Do you think it could work anyway?
Yes, with good storage, it can be fine.
And the landlord, does he seem serious?
Yes, he was very professional and clear.
005: I found an apartment that I really like.
Great! Have you already sent your application file?
Not yet, I'm missing a proof of employment.
You can ask your employer for a certificate.
That's true, I'll send him an email.
Hurry up, good apartments go quickly.
006: The landlord asked me for a deposit of two months.
That's fairly common in this city.
Yes, but that's a lot of money to put out.
Have you thought about the rental guarantee?
That's a good idea, I'll look into it.
It can really help you pay less upfront.
007: I signed the lease for the apartment!
Thanks, I'm really happy with my choice.
Have you thought about getting renter's insurance?
Yes, it's planned for next week.
Perfect, all you have left to do is move in.
008: I have to give back my current apartment at the end of the month.
Did you notify the landlord on time?
Yes, I sent him the certified letter.
Very good, and did you do the move-in inspection?
Not yet, we set a date together.
Remember to clean well before he comes over.
009: I'm looking for a roommate for my apartment.
Do you already have some candidates in mind?
Yes, a student is coming to visit tomorrow.
What are you going to ask her, exactly?
It's important to understand each other well from the start.
010: I booked a hotel for the weekend in Lyon.
Did you find a good deal?
Yes, three nights for two hundred forty euros.
That's a good price for the city center.
You got a great deal, enjoy it!
